nodes.label: laptop memory - infer context like a human

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. The user always, without exception, phrases messages against the immediately preceding conversation: 'What do you think you're doing atm?' after discussing a piece of work means state your understanding of the current work so I can steer it, not report your idle state. Over-literal, rigid answers are as much a failure as over-acting. His words, 2026-07-16: 'I EXPECT you to infer context via human language... answering in the max-autistic way is the absolute opposite of that.' Read every message as a continuation of the last exchange and answer the intended question in a few plain sentences; caution belongs in actions, not in stilted communication. CANON_AUDIT.md 4.12 verdict: GROUNDED, near-verbatim
